jobs.prompt:
FILE ACCESS: your declared outputs are readable. Train 8 owner gate, second pass. The change-driven snapshot refresh is in tools/watch-server.mjs, but the 10-minute idle soak still shows 13.5% decaying-average server CPU (limit 5%) because full board rebuilds cost ~3 s each and the deep backstop is 120 s. Two fixes:
1. tools/watch-server.mjs: in rebuildCommandCenterSnapshot, `changesSinceFullRebuild = false` is set BEFORE the build's own inputDetector.scan(), and the scan's changed ids set it true again, so a rebuild can immediately re-arm the next refresh. Move the reset to AFTER that scan (just before the entry is cached), so the build's own catch-up changes count as part of this snapshot. A change that arrives after the scan is picked up by the next 1 s detector tick and re-arms the flag. Also change the default `snapshotMaxStaleMs` from 120000 to 300000 (5 minutes). The 60 s TTL stays: a watched input change still refreshes at the next request after 60 s; the 5-minute deep rebuild is only the backstop for inputs the live detector does not watch (idle family roots and machine totals).
2. tools/watch-soak.mjs: RSS_GROWTH_KB_MAX = 512 is not a usable flat test for a Node server that holds a ~150 MB working set after the first deep build; the 10-minute run showed a one-time rise to the high-water mark and then a flat plateau while the browser heap stayed flat. Raise the RSS growth threshold to 65536 KB (64 MB over the run) and keep the heap threshold at 2 MB and the CPU average at 5%. Document in the constant comment that this bounds a real leak (about 1 MB/minute) while allowing the one-time build peak. Keep the leak verdict and exit 1.

Tests: update tests/command-center-perf-budget.test.mjs for the new default (pass snapshotMaxStaleMs explicitly where it pins 120000/300000) and add a regression that after a full rebuild with no further input change, no second full rebuild starts for at least another snapshotTtlMs (proves the reset order). Keep every existing test green. Update tests/command-center-soak.test.mjs only if it pins the old RSS threshold.

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/command-center-perf-budget.test.mjs tests/command-center-soak.test.mjs tests/command-center-live.test.mjs tests/watch-server.test.mjs -> all pass. Report rebuild counts in the tests.
